messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['To address this, Standard Bank has released a 128-bit SSL update for the online banking page that eliminates this bug.', 'We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance of banking software, that operates customer database for Alliance & Leicester Internet banking users.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Espera-se que todas as equipes migrem para o novo Microsoft Outlook Web Professional Plus 2020 para permitir o acesso aos recursos abaixo e muito mais.', 'This e-mail is to notify you the staff and students of CornellUniversity that we will be upgrading our server.', 'Notice! Outlook Webmail IT Service desk initiates new data bandwidth, effect from 6:00PM today to Thursday <6th> 6:00PM due to server overload, all accounts will be moving from current H drive to the new database shortly.', 'This notice is to alert you that our database security system has detected a virus on your Cornell, edu email account.', 'This is to notify that new updates have been released for Skype.', 'We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance of banking software, that operates customer database for Frost Bank Cash Manager service.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
